answer.text: The engine number is punched on the bottom of the gear pedal connector rod.
The VIN is a 17-digit number punched on the right side steering head tube, in the form of a label.

watchouts.text: Do not tamper with or alter the VIN or engine number. The manual says this is illegal and will void the vehicle registration and warranty.

watchout_review.reason: One watchout cites E2: the caution against altering the VIN and engine numbers.
